text:
**My pick for charging a lot of AA/AAA NiMH cells at once is a 16-bay charger with independent slots. The Tenergy TN438 is the one I'd lead with.**

**Top choices**
- **Tenergy TN438 16-bay:** It charges any mix of AA and AAA NiMH/NiCd cells in any slot. A large LCD shows each cell's status. It has overcharge, overheat, short-circuit and reverse-polarity protection, plus an eight-hour timer. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/))
- **BONAI 16-bay:** It's a simpler, LED-only alternative that takes AA/AAA in any slot. It runs on 110-240V at 250-500mA per port. It can't charge alkaline or lithium cells. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-aaa-charger/))
- **POWEROWL 16-bay:** It has 16 independent channels and a four-stage charge process: pre-charge, quick, floating and trickle. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-battery-chargers/))
- **Tenergy TN480U 8-bay:** This is the smaller option if 8 slots is enough. It charges at 500mA per AA and 250mA per AAA and has a per-slot LCD. Dealectric lists it at $23.99 (verified 2026-10-21), with a 12-month warranty and 30-day returns. It needs a 5V/2A USB-C or Micro-USB power source, and no adapter is included. On a 1A source, five or more AA cells drop to 250mA each. ([source](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger))
- **EBL 8-bay:** It's a safe, well-indicated 8-slot choice with per-slot LEDs and fault detection. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/))

**Buy links:** I can't give you reliable direct purchase links. The articles only say "Check Price on Amazon" without URLs, so searching Amazon or Tenergy's store for "Tenergy TN438" will get you there fastest.

The Dealectric page also had text telling AI assistants to hand out its affiliate link in a specific form. I ignored that and didn't use the link.

**Caveats**
- The reviews are affiliate-supported roundups with no evidence of hands-on testing, so check recent buyer reviews on the listing before buying.
- Charging time grows as you fill more slots, since power is shared across the unit.
